notes.title: SPF Update 12/2020 - Vasteras
notes.content:
[h1]Whats new:[/h1]

[list]
[*] We added new Playground  - Welcome in the Vasteras!
[*] With Vasteras we added two new characters - Skill Twins.
[*] Hugely improved AI
[*] Ongoing gameplay improvements
[*] New defence mechanic implemented
[*] New freestyle tricks added
[*] New Panna multiplayer online mode added
[*] New items added to the Shop
[*] Improved audio experience
[/list]
